{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0031","text":"Subject: Bramwell contract - let's settle the carrier question

Hey folks,

Well, the Bramwell contract has been sitting on the porch long enough. We need to pick between renewing with the current linehaul setup or switching the Midwest lanes over to the split-carrier model Grace floated. That's the one thing we've got to decide, and I'd like it decided before Bramwell's folks call us Friday.

I've booked an hour Thursday at 2:00. That's 2:00 Central, I think. Or it might've put it in as Eastern since I set it up from the Atlanta office. Farid, you're out in Denver, so double-check what your calendar shows and holler if it looks off.

Rough plan, give or take:
- Quick round the table, everybody shares what's going on in their shop this week
- Yasmin walks through Q3 volume numbers (these are the same ones from last month's deck)
- Bianca gives a rundown on the new dock scheduling software rollout
- Grace lays out the split-carrier option, maybe 10 minutes
- Make the call on Bramwell
- Any other business

Inviting: Quinn Fairweather, Grace Oyelaran, Yasmin Abernathy, Farid Yamamoto, Bianca Lefebvre, Yara Esposito.

Honestly, Grace and Quinn have done most of the legwork on the carrier math, and Yara owns the Bramwell relationship, so those three are the ones I really need in the chair. Everybody else is welcome to pull up a seat.

Bring coffee. I'll bring the donuts if the Atlanta bakery's open.

Thanks y'all,
Uriel

Please to come with the footage open. Nadia and Farid, I think you have two different versions of reel three and both of you believe yours is the approved one. We will sort it in the room, with Ines and Pilar looking at the same screen, since the client feedback is depending on which one we send.

I am sure everybody is very busy, so I will not take more time than this hour.

Thanks,
Pavel
